deviations.what: Canvas 1 'O0 Splash · the sealed mark and the lockup, nothing else' (and c11 'O0 Splash'): the wordmark 'Rukka Folio' is drawn at ~20 px; the app draws it at the display role (~36 px), nearly twice the frame's size
deviations.reason: [screen] the splash picks text.displayLarge for the lockup; the frame's size maps to the section role (20), as S0.06's lockup already does
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (a canvas size maps to its type role); design/match/S0.06.json (same lockup at type.section)

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O0 Splash: 'Folio' is drawn in the muted text colour at a light weight; the app draws 'Folio' at weight 300 in full ink, so the two words read as one colour
deviations.reason: [screen] the frame's second word takes the muted ink (status.muted); DESIGN-PACK O0 rules only the weight (300), which the app keeps

deviations.what: Canvas 1 O0 Splash: the mark sits on the vertical centre of the screen with the wordmark below it; in the app the mark-plus-wordmark column is centred as one group, so the mark sits ~60 px higher than the frame's
deviations.reason: [screen] the Column is centred as a whole (Center › Column min); the frame centres the mark itself

deviations.what: Capture note, canvas 1 O0 Splash: captured with reducedMotion: true so the (invisible) loader rule is held still and the tree settles; the locked branch draws the same frame either way.
